A cookie is a small text file stored in your browser so a website can recognise it. Here is how veyro.dk uses cookies.

Your consent

On your first visit, you can choose which cookies to accept. Essential cookies are always set because the site cannot work without them. All other cookies are set only if you agree.

You can change or withdraw your consent at any time through Cookie settings at the bottom of the page. Your choice is stored in your browser for 12 months, after which you are asked again.

Essential cookies

  • veyro_language (veyro.dk): remembers the language you choose for 12 months. Saved only when you use the language selector.
  • veyro_cart (veyro.dk): remembers what you have added to your cart. Deleted after 30 days or when you send your request.
  • theme-cookie-consent (stored locally in the browser): remembers your cookie choice for 12 months.

The customer portal (kunde.veyro.dk)

The customer portal uses only two essential cookies, which keep you logged in and protect the forms. They are set without consent because the portal cannot work without them, and there are no analytics or marketing cookies.

  • __Host-vk_session (kunde.veyro.dk): keeps you logged in. Deleted after 30 days or when you log out.
  • __Host-vk_csrf (kunde.veyro.dk): protects forms such as login against forged requests. Deleted after 2 hours.

Payments and payment card changes take place on Stripe’s own pages, which follow Stripe’s cookie rules.
